entities.name: Mihrdat V of Iberia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mihrdat V, of the Chosroid Dynasty, was the king (mepe) of Iberia reigning, according to a medieval Georgian literary tradition, for 12 years, from c. 435 to 447.
